object.attr: stakeholder: a link records what a requirement derives from or verifies, which is in its own document or a declared parent. Requirements that several components share go in a common parent document. Links that a removed parent declaration leaves behind are reported by validation (handed to MELLON-CHECK-SRS).
object.description: If a new link's target object is in neither the source object's document nor a parent document of that document, Mellon shall refuse to create the link.
